message.content: Task: cut CI queue time. In .github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml the two Release Artifact Preflight macOS jobs (macos-arm64, macos-x64) run on every PR, and the org macOS runner limit makes PRs wait 40+ minutes. Make those two macOS preflight jobs run only on pushes to main and on PRs that touch release- or build-relevant paths (the release workflow, crates/callisto-graph/src/templates/**, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, rust-toolchain*, .github/actions/**, callisto.toml, the preflight scripts). The macOS test suite still runs on every PR, and the Linux preflights stay unchanged. Prefer a path-filter job (an existing pinned action, or git diff in a step) that feeds an if: condition, so the required-check names still report: a skipped job must count as passing, not missing, for branch protection. Check how required checks are configured (gh api repos/orin-dx/callisto/rulesets) and keep them satisfiable. Update .github/tests/verify-release-workflow-policy.sh or the workflow-contracts tests only if they assert on these jobs. Worktree name wp-ci-macos-preflight-scope, trail #357. No changeset (CI only). Gate: just workflow-contracts and just pre-push by exit code; skip cargo-heavy gates unless you touch Rust. Rules (from the lead session close-gap-for-alpha): Read AGENTS.md first and follow its invariant ladder: a type or private constructor first, then exhaustive match, then an existing lint, then one test at the real boundary; delete per-call-site checks the new type makes redundant and migrate every sibling call site in the same PR. No new traits, async, journals or frameworks; no new error codes, JSON keys or flags without asking the lead first. Work in a named worktree off fresh origin/main (EnterWorktree name=<given>). Write the failing test first. Gate by exit code: just pre-push, just lint, just doc-check, just test, just ci; cargo mutants --in-place --in-diff on the Rust diff with zero missed or argued equivalents in the PR body; never commit mutants.out* (restore mutants.out.old from HEAD only if tracked). Run one fresh Opus reviewer subagent on the diff and apply what holds up. Changeset via `cargo run -p callisto-cli -- add --package cargo/callisto-cli:<bump> --summary "..."` only for user-visible changes, written for users. Signed commits, no session trailer. Right before pushing, merge the latest origin/main (no rebase, no force-push) and re-run the gates if it moved. Push with git push origin HEAD:refs/heads/<branch>, confirm with git ls-remote, link to the given Entire trail and open with entire trail ci-pr. If Entire raises findings, fix the ones that cause a wrong result, broken recovery, a security issue or a check that cannot fail; report the rest to the lead. Resolve a finding only after the fix is on the remote. When done, send the lead (close-gap-for-alpha) one report: PR number, sha, gates run, and anything not verified. CARGO_BUILD_JOBS is cores/5; never run two cargo builds in one worktree.

name: Callisto CI & Validation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  merge_group:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  workflow-contracts:
    name: Workflow Contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install workflow validation tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2
        with:
          tool: ripgrep,zizmor@1.30.0
      - name: Lint workflow and action metadata
        # actionlint v1.7.12 predates GitHub's documented $/ self-repository
        # syntax. Keep all other actionlint diagnostics strict.
        uses: docker://rhysd/actionlint@sha256:9d36088643581e728c969f35141f88139fec77280b2be23c1f66f8e40e1025e7 # v1.7.12
        with:
          # Docker action arguments are passed directly, rather than through a
          # shell. Keep the exception as one argument so its regex is intact.
          args: -color -ignore=\$/.+
      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - name: Audit workflow and action security
        run: just zizmor
      - name: Verify workflow contracts
        run: just workflow-contracts

  fmt:
    name: Code Formatting (Moon & Just)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - run: just fmt-check

  clippy:
    name: Clippy Lints (Moon & Just)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          components: clippy
      - run: just lint
      - run: just doc-check
      - run: just fuzz-check

  msrv:
    name: Minimum Supported Rust Version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install the declared rust-version
        run: |
          msrv=$(sed -n 's/^rust-version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          rustup toolchain install "$msrv" --profile minimal
          echo "RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=$msrv" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - run: cargo check --workspace --all-targets --locked

  test:
    name: Test Suite (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@cfdb7ed4ccc7c7dce37759eae89dc5674b469b39 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest
      - name: Install workflow linters

execute="$(sed -n '/^  execute:$/,$p' "$workflow")"
require_line "$execute" '    needs: [plan, build, package-crates, release-candidate, gate]' 'PR merge is the release approval; execute must depend directly on the plan and verified build, not a GitHub Environment gate'
require_line "$execute" '            cmp "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" "$build_dir/release-intent/release-intent.json"' 'execute must reject a build handoff whose immutable intent differs from planning'
require_line "$execute" '          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent' 'execute must download release-intent outside the workspace -- callisto release execute re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which fails closed on any untracked file in the worktree'
require_line "$execute" '          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build' 'execute must download release-build outside the workspace -- callisto release execute re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which fails closed on any untracked file in the worktree'
require_line "$execute" '          path: release-source' 'execute must use an explicit release-source checkout'
require_line "$execute" '          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}' 'execution must pass the coordinator revision through an environment variable'
require_line "$execute" '          args=(--source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" --intent "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" --receipt "$receipt_dir/release-receipt.json" --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA")' 'execute must pass the explicit source checkout, coordinator revision, and mandatory receipt path to the current Callisto coordinator'

ci_workflow=.github/workflows/callisto-ci.yml
checkout_count=$(rg -n 'uses: actions/checkout@' "$ci_workflow" | wc -l)
credential_free_checkout_count=$(rg -n 'persist-credentials: false' "$ci_workflow" | wc -l)
if [[ "$checkout_count" != "$credential_free_checkout_count" ]]; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: every Callisto CI checkout must disable persisted credentials\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

require_line "$version_pr" '          persist-credentials: false' 'version-pr never git-pushes -- it commits through the forge API -- so it must not persist Git credentials'

if ! rg -Fqx '      - run: just release-workflow-behavior' "$ci_workflow"; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: PR CI must run the behavioral release workflow harness\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! rg -Fqx '  release-artifact-preflight:' "$ci_workflow"; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: PR CI must preflight every production artifact build recipe\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! rg -Fqx '        run: just workflow-contracts' "$ci_workflow" \
  || ! rg -Fqx '    bash .github/tests/test-release-artifact-build-script.sh' justfile; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: CI must test the shared release artifact build script\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

if ! rg -Fqx '          - id: macos-arm64' "$ci_workflow" \
  || ! rg -Fqx '            target: aarch64-apple-darwin' "$ci_workflow" \
  || ! rg -Fqx '            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu' "$ci_workflow" \
  || ! rg -Fqx '            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl' "$ci_workflow"; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: artifact preflight must cover all three product targets\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

execute="$(sed -n '/^  execute:$/,$p' "$workflow")"
require_line "$execute" '          persist-credentials: true' 'execute pushes the release tag with a plain git push (dispatch_tag) -- unlike every other job it has no other way to authenticate, so it must persist Git credentials'

if rg -n '^  environment-policy:$|^    environment: release$' "$workflow" > /dev/null; then
  printf 'release workflow contract failed: a merged release PR is the only approval; no Environment reviewer gate may delay execute\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

if rg -U 'run: \|(?s:.*?)\$\{\{ inputs\.' .github/actions/setup-callisto/action.yml > /dev/null; then
  printf 'workflow contract failed: composite-action inputs must enter shell through named environment variables\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

PR #593 is open for trail #357, but the macOS jobs are untested on GitHub: I haven't seen the PR's CI run, so neither skip nor run has happened there yet. I also didn't check whether Entire raised findings, and I haven't sent the lead (close-gap-for-alpha) a report; this is it.

- **Branch and commit:** `ci/macos-preflight-scope`, commit `e7b2906f07683679b89a92bb5967030721e30cc7`. The remote matches the local commit and GitHub reports the signature as `valid`. `origin/main` hadn't moved, so there was nothing to merge.
- **Gates:** `just workflow-contracts` and `just pre-push` both exited 0. I ran them again after the reviewer's fixes. I skipped `just lint`, `just doc-check`, `just test`, `just ci` and mutants because no Rust changed.
- **Reviewer:** an Opus reviewer's `just workflow-contracts` and `actionlint` runs both exited 0. It found three things, and I fixed all three. A large diff could kill the scope step on SIGPIPE and skip macOS on a PR that should run it. The diff base is now `HEAD^1`, so it no longer depends on the payload's base SHA. `--no-renames` makes a file moved out of a watched path count.

What the PR changes:
- **Scope job:** a new `macos-preflight-scope` job on ubuntu uses `.github/scripts/macos-preflight-scope.sh` to decide whether the macOS preflights run. Push and `merge_group` always run them. A PR runs them only if it touches one of these paths:
  - `callisto-release.yml` or `callisto-ci.yml`
  - `build-release-artifact.sh`
  - `.github/actions/**`
  - `crates/callisto-graph/src/templates/**`
  - any `Cargo.toml` (root or nested), `Cargo.lock`, `callisto.toml` or `rust-toolchain*`
- **CI workflow:** I added `callisto-ci.yml` to the list so edits to the preflight job exercise it. You can drop it if you disagree.
- **Job split:** the two macOS entries moved into their own job, `release-artifact-preflight-macos`, because a job-level `if` can't see matrix values. The Linux job keeps its name and entries. The macOS test suite is unchanged.
- **Test:** `.github/tests/test-macos-preflight-scope.sh` runs the real script on sample paths, including a large-diff case. It is registered in `just workflow-contracts`.

- **Required checks:** the `main` ruleset has no required status checks, so nothing blocks on the skipped jobs. When the macOS job is skipped, GitHub reports it under the literal name `Release Artifact Preflight (${{ matrix.id }})`, not `(macos-arm64)` or `(macos-x64)`. If those per-target names are ever made required, skipped PRs would hang, so you'd need a single always-run gate job instead.
